# POSHPLEX

> POSHPLEX is a premium streetwear and fashion brand from Bangladesh. We design, produce, and ship limited-run apparel and accessories nationwide with cash-on-delivery and online payment options.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest drops, featured collections, and brand highlights.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse all product categories.
- [Blog](/blog): Streetwear stories, style guides, drops, and brand news.
- [Membership](/membership): Member benefits and the public POSHPLEX directory.
- [Order Tracking](/order-tracking): Track an order by number, phone, or email.
- [Our Story](/pages/our-story): How POSHPLEX was founded by the Hossan brothers.
- [Store Locator](/pages/store-locator): Visit address, contact, and inquiry form.
- [Shipping & Delivery](/pages/shipping-delivery): Charges, timelines, and COD policy across Bangladesh.
- [Privacy Policy](/pages/privacy-policy): How we collect, use, and protect customer data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/pages/terms-conditions): Order, payment, return, and exchange terms.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Customer login with phone or email.
- [Favorites](/favorites): Wishlist of saved products.
